name: cursor
description: Textured cursor pipeline with hover types and a ready-to-use factory
postInstallNotes:
## cursor block installed

Wire the cursor into a screen:

1. Load cursor textures (one per `CursorType` you use) in `Load()`.
2. Call `MonoDreams.Cursor.Cursor.Create(world, textures, RenderTargetID.HUD)` — returns the cursor entity.
3. Add to your update pipeline (order matters):
   - `CursorInputSystem` early (reads mouse state)
   - `CursorPositionSystem` AFTER camera updates (uses camera + viewport to project to world space)
   - `CursorDrawPrepSystem` AFTER position is finalized (populates `DrawComponent`)

The cursor renders on `RenderTargetID.HUD` by default so it sits above the game world and UI.

See `MonoDreams.Examples/Screens/LevelSelectionScreen.cs` for a working reference.
